build_optimizer: build a PyTorch optimizer from a name string and model parameters with configurable hyperparameters
adjust_learning_rate: adjust the learning rate of an optimizer using cosine decay with linear warmup scheduling
get_dataloader: get a PyTorch DataLoader for images in a directory with optional transforms and batch size
use_MetricLogger: use the MetricLogger class to track and log smoothed training metrics over an iterable
get_image_paths: get a sorted list of all image file paths recursively from a directory using LRU cache
